import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getNewcomerClaimData } from '@src/response-apps/recharge/newcomerClaim/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 新人狂欢返利指令
 * 领取指定天数的奖励
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  try {
    const result = await getNewcomerClaimData(bid, uid, e.MessageText, createBackendRequestContext(e));
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    switch (result.code) {
      case 'NO_MATCH':
        md.addText('请指定要领取的天数，例如：新人返利领取 1');
        {
          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
        }

        return;
      case 'INVALID_DAY':
        md.addText(`请输入有效的天数（1-${result.maxDays}）`);
        {
          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
        }

        return;
      case 'NOT_IN_PERIOD': {
        const repeatMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, '您已过新人期，无法领取新人狂欢奖励。', createBackendRequestContext(e));

        md.addText(repeatMsg);

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }
      case 'NOT_UNLOCKED':
        md.addText(`第${result.dayIndex}天奖励尚未解锁，请等待活动进度。`);
        {
          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
        }

        return;
      case 'INSUFFICIENT_RECHARGE':
        md.addText('今日充值不足，达到当日充值门槛后才能领取奖励。');
        {
          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
        }

        return;
      case 'FAILED':
        md.addText(result.error);
        {
          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
        }

        return;
      case 'SUCCESS':
        md.addText(`解锁第${result.dayIndex}天奖励！`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`获得：${result.rewardText}`);
        {
          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '新人返利', content: md }));
        }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('领取新人狂欢奖励失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('领取失败，请稍后再试。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});
